compatibility_changes: Pinned Bevy 0.19.1; lock resolves wgpu/wgpu-hal 29.0.4. No runtime Java/JavaScript/Python dependency added.

Synthetic MouseWheel messages use TouchPhase::Moved, matching ordinary mouse-wheel semantics.
Render diagnostic sets follow PrepareViews; parked-window ordering regression passes.
Keep custom executor-draining shutdown plugin; update deprecated test-only non-send insertion.
Headless gallery/connected fixtures initialize the new skinned-mesh asset resource required by VisibilityPlugin; all existing geometry assertions retained.

native_interpretation: Both native processes completed all 38 scripted architecture actions, 33 successful isolated saves and clean exit; built-in exact cached-geometry checks remained active.
The first run’s maximum render join was 4499 ms (frame 4); the repeat maximum was 121 ms. A cold/warm effect is plausible, not established. No exclusive CPU/GPU stack attribution was collected.

The maximum acquisition scheduling brackets were 1.62 and 1.18 ms, but there were no occlusion notifications and the desktop was locked. The acquisition guard can skip drawing, so these times prove neither visible presentation nor a fix for prior unlocked intermittent pauses.
Repository collapse acceptance was 116.44 and 99.32 ms. Two uncontrolled CPU observations do not close the <100 ms navigation target.
Each process warned that a Destroyed event for an unknown winit window was skipped during exit; both returned 0 without a timeout. No startup/active-work close action was exercised.
upstream_source_findings: wgpu-hal checks NSWindow occlusion state before Metal nextDrawable and returns Occluded. It still has no seen-visible startup guard in this version.
prepare_windows handles CurrentSurfaceTexture::Occluded without a texture and skips windows without a writing camera except initial presentation.
RenderRecovery can skip First/Render while not ready. Missing/short surface brackets are not presentation evidence; initialization/recovery also enters the extract callback.
Pipelined channel destructor still waits for render world; retain the application shutdown drain.
